tree-blue.displayName: Tree Blue (slope illustration and layer stack)

layer-edge.displayName: Layer Edge (thickness edge, layer stack only)

display.purpose: The single hero headline, centred in the sky; the 2xl step on phones.

headline.purpose: Act titles as short declarative sentences ("Der Chip.", "Die App.", "Das sind wir.").

headline-sm.purpose: Rider panel names (600, line-height 1), team first names, mobile act titles. The second hero line is its own heading at 540, the 3xl step (2xl on phones).

title.purpose: Step names in the chip act, the rider panel use line.

title-xl.purpose: App step titles (600, -0.025em; lg step on phones).

lede.purpose: Sentence under the hero headline (max 34ch), line under an act title, app step text.

body.purpose: Running copy in slate soft, 62ch measure; panel text 30ch.

label.purpose: Step descriptions, demo status and cancel hint, button text.

caption.purpose: Placeholder and sketch notes, footer, demonstration badge.

nav-link.purpose: Section links in the side sheet: Funnel Sans 500 at the base step, slate soft, plain and small.

diagram-label.purpose: Part names of the layer stack: Funnel Display 560, 21px in the 640-wide drawing (26px on phones), ink.

shadows.name: sc-e1
shadows.purpose: Dark pill button and rail arrows (dropped when disabled).

shadows.name: sc-e2
shadows.purpose: Floating back-to-top circle and the framed slope illustration.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Frosted side sheet; thrown to the right, away from the edge it slides from.

shadows.name: ground-cast-hero
shadows.purpose: Ellipse under the hero chip; drawn as a background, not a box-shadow.

shadows.name: ground-cast
shadows.purpose: Ellipse under the app phone sketch; drawn as a background, not a box-shadow.

shadows.name: frost-glass
shadows.value: background: rgba(248, 251, 253, 0.66); backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(170%); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)
shadows.purpose: Side sheet material; solid rgba(248, 251, 253, 0.97) where backdrop-filter is unsupported.

motion.name: sc-d-fast
motion.purpose: Button background, border and press transitions.

motion.name: sc-d-base
motion.purpose: Header bar turning white on scroll; back-to-top fade and 0.5rem slide-in.

motion.name: back-to-top
motion.value: visible after 1.2 viewports; smooth scroll to top, instant under prefers-reduced-motion (160ms opacity fade only); focus moves to the wordmark

motion.name: hold
motion.value: short press: group paths over 2.2s; hold 1s, then 2s cancel window in the demonstration (real chip 3s and 5s, stated in the hint; second press cancels), then the emergency path draws to the station, the station pings, a red ring pulses around the fallen person and the rescuer rides his trail to them, on its own; end state at once under reduced motion

motion.name: snowfall
motion.value: canvas particles, 22 on desktop, 12 below 700px; off under prefers-reduced-motion

motion.name: sc-d-slow
motion.purpose: Active-step underline growing across the step list.

motion.name: app-sketch
motion.value: route, track and radius drawn from the pinned act progress (--sc-p); end state under reduced motion

motion.name: hero-scrub
motion.value: 2.6 viewports, no dwell; footage scales 1 to 1.14 with --sc-p, headline block lifts 9vh (4vh on phones) and fades out by about 26%; the second line (h2) assembles line by line (kinetic lines) and holds from about 40% to 96%; chip and its cast rise 6vh and scale to 1.5; transforms off under reduced motion

motion.name: app-steps
motion.value: persistent list; active and passed headings turn ink over sc-d-slow, active bar ink; nothing fades out

motion.name: side-sheet
motion.value: non-modal; hover on the wordmark opens after 90ms on fine pointers, leaving wordmark and sheet closes after 260ms; click, tap, Enter open; Esc, close button or a press outside close; slide from translateX(-100%) and 60% opacity over 240ms in, 200ms out, sc-ease-out; no animation under reduced motion; wordmark chevron rotates 180deg over sc-d-base while open; links change colour and ground over sc-d-fast

motion.name: layer-stack
motion.value: driven by the pinned act's --sc-p: spread e = clamp((p - 0.06) / 0.5); each layer moves translateY(k * e * 64px), k from -2.5 to 2.5; labels fade in from p 0.18, staggered by 0.055 each over 0.1; lid LED blends terrain blue to emergency red over p 0.62 to 0.72 (color-mix in oklab); fully spread with all labels without .sc-ready or under reduced motion

motion.name: photo-reveal
motion.value: the mountain photo frame wipes up (reveal up) as the act enters, with parallax inside the frame

motion.name: rail
motion.value: plain flow section, not scroll-driven; snapping native scroller; arrow tap steps one panel (smooth unless reduced motion), arrow hold scrolls about 0.28px/ms with snap off until release; mouse drag; arrows disabled at the ends

motion.name: team-rules
motion.value: flow act; each name's 2px ink top rule draws from the left (scaleX 0 to 1, 900ms sc-ease-out, delay 200ms + 140ms per name); role fades in and rises 6px (600ms, delay 520ms + 140ms per name); name shifts 6px right on hover over sc-d-base on fine pointers; end state under reduced motion

components.name: Step List
components.description: Three steps under a hairline; the active step gets a 2px ink underline.
components.html:
1. Kurz drückenDeine Gruppe spürt eine Vibration und sieht in der App, wo du bist.
  2. Drei Sekunden haltenDer Notruf startet. Fünf Sekunden lang kannst du ihn abbrechen.
  3. Hilfe kommtDer nächste Mitarbeiter der Bergbahn macht sich auf den Weg.
components.css: .ds-gesten { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid #c7d4e2; font-family: 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-gesten li { position: relative; padding-top: 1rem; } .ds-gesten li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 2px; background: #1b2430; transition: width 420ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-gesten li.ist-aktiv::before, .ds-gesten li:hover::before { width: 100%; } .ds-gesten b { display: block; font-family: 'Funnel Display', 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #1b2430; } .ds-gesten span { display: block; margin-top: 0.35rem; color: #4a586a; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Rider Panel
components.description: Typographic panel on the native horizontal scroller: hairline top rule, name, use line, short sentence; the closing panel carries a 2px ink rule.

components.css: .ds-wir { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2.5rem; font-family: 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1b2430; } .ds-wir li { position: relative; padding-top: 1rem; } .ds-wir li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: #1b2430; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: 0 50%; transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) calc(var(--n) * 140ms + 200ms); } .ds-wir:hover li::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-wir__name { display: block; font-family: 'Funnel Display', 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 2.6rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-wir li:hover .ds-wir__name { transform: translateX(6px); } .ds-wir__rolle { display: block; margin-top: 0.4rem; max-width: 26ch; color: #4a586a; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); transition: opacity 600ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) calc(var(--n) * 140ms + 520ms), transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) calc(var(--n) * 140ms + 520ms); } .ds-wir:hover .ds-wir__rolle { opacity: 1; transform: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-wir li::before, .ds-wir__rolle { transform: none; opacity: 1; transition: none; } }

components.name: Side Sheet
components.description: Non-modal frosted-glass sheet from the left, opened by hovering the wordmark (fine pointers) or click/Enter; head row (wordmark linking to the top, close button) and a plain section list in Funnel Sans 500, current section ink on a 70% white 14px plane, hover on 50% white. No veil, no bar.

narrative.overview:
The page is a bright winter morning. High-key snow white and pale glacier blue carry every surface; the only dark is slate ink, used for words, line drawings and the one action. The chip stands on that snow as a flat line drawing with a cold blue cast shadow underneath, the way a thing lies on fresh powder. Mountain footage (Mixkit stock) is scrubbed by scroll and dissolves downward into the white ground through a mask, never a drawn edge; a light snowfall on a canvas is the atmosphere of the first viewport.

Density is low and the air is generous. Each act of the scroll does one thing: a centred headline in the sky that gives way to a second line assembling itself, the chip to try beside an illustrated slope in soft blues that answers the press, the chip taken apart into its layers, a framed photo of a group on the mountain that wipes up into view, the app sketched in a phone outline, a sideways rail of typographic rider panels the visitor scrolls by hand, then the team. The page is an introduction only: it ends with the team act and a plain footer, and has no rental or purchase surface. Honesty is a visual element: placeholders and sketches are labelled in a small caption directly under the thing they stand for, and the interactive demo carries a pill that says it is a demonstration.

The world refuses the dark gadget page with a glowing device and three feature cards. Colour is not decoration here: there is no accent hue at all, only ink-dark for action and a single emergency red that belongs to the alarm.

The scroll mechanism is the ScrollCraft engine (`scrollcraft.css`/`.js`, unchanged). This system is the set of overrides of its `--sc-*` tokens plus the page's own tokens and classes in `seite.css`; the engine's spacing and type scales are inherited as they are.
keyCharacteristics: High-key snow grounds, slate ink, no accent hue.
Emergency red appears only where the emergency itself is shown.

Flat slate line drawings (chip, phone) with rounded caps; things that stand get a blurred cold blue cast ellipse. The demo slope and the layer stack are the filled illustrations, painted only in the snow and soft-blue family.

Footage masked into the white ground and scrubbed: it zooms gently while the headline lifts and fades, the second line assembles line by line and the chip rises and grows to 1.5 with its cast; sparse snowfall as atmosphere, removed under reduced motion.
Soft, blue-tinted, offset shadows; hairlines in shadow blue, a 2px ink rule only for emphasis or the active step.
One frosted-glass plane: the side sheet, translucent snow over the page, never a dark veil.
Every placeholder and sketch labelled where it stands.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no brand hue. Action is slate ink on snow; no control, link, text or highlight is turquoise, blue-filled or gradient-lit. The soft blues and gradients of the slope illustration are terrain and sky, not accent.

rules.name: The Red Is The Alarm Rule
rules.body: Emergency red marks the emergency and nothing else: not links, not errors, not prices, not decoration, not the group call, not a child leaving the radius. If a surface does not depict an emergency call, it has no red.

rules.name: The Mid-Weight Rule
rules.body: Display weights stay between 480 and 640; hierarchy comes from size and tracking, never from 800-weight shouting.

rules.name: The Sentence Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines are short declarative German sentences with a full stop. Nothing sits above them; supporting lines go below.

rules.name: The Air Rule
rules.body: One idea per viewport. If an act needs a second idea, it gets its own scroll distance rather than a denser grid.

rules.name: The Cold Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blue, never black or grey, and they fall downward with blur (the side sheet's falls away from its edge). Hard offset shadows do not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Standing Object Rule
rules.body: A drawn thing that stands on the page gets a blurred cold blue ellipse beneath it, never a box shadow.

dos: Do keep every ground in the snow family (`snow-canvas`, `snow-surface`, `glacier-drift`) and let acts drift between them.
Do make the one action a slate ink pill; there is one per view. The back-to-top circle is fixed chrome, not a second action.
Do set a standing drawn object on a cold blue cast ellipse.
Do dissolve footage into the white ground with a mask, and label stock, sketches and placeholders honestly.
Do tint every shadow with the cold shadow hue and keep it blurred and offset downward.
Do keep snowfall sparse (22 flakes on desktop, 12 on phones); remove it, give drawn paths their end state and make scrolling instant under reduced motion.

Do draw objects and group paths in slate line work and people as small ink silhouettes; ink is the emergency path and the active state. Fill the slope illustration only from the Illustration Blues and the snow family, the layer stack only from the Layer Stack Blues and the snow family.
Do keep the side sheet non-modal frosted glass with its solid fallback; it blurs the page, it never dims it.
donts: Don't introduce an accent hue; the engine accent stays slate ink.
Don't use emergency red for anything that is not the emergency itself.
Don't build a dark gadget page with a glowing device or a row of three feature cards; panels are typographic, without boxes.
Don't put kickers or eyebrows above headlines.
Don't use black or grey shadows, hard offset shadows, or drawn snowbanks; black exists only as a mask stop.
Don't show a placeholder object, sketch or team image without its caption.
